policy_rules: Tele Consultation (GP & Specialist): Unlimited, Cashless
Health Check: 1 Health Check per family up to INR 1200, Cashless
In-Clinic Consultations (GP & Specialist): Allopathy consultations up to INR 6000, Cashless + Reimbursement
Prescribed Diagnostics: Covers Pathology & Radiology prescribed by Allopathic practitioner up to INR 5000, Cashless + Reimbursement
Vaccination: WHO-approved vaccinations for adults and children up to INR 2500, Cashless + Reimbursement
Prescribed Pharmacy: Medicines prescribed by Allopathic practitioner up to INR 5000, Cashless + Reimbursement

Dental Wellness: Covers Examination, Scaling and Polishing (in case of root canal and extraction), X-ray, Fluoride Treatment, Filling, Prophylaxis, Root Canal Treatment, Extractions, Oral Surgery, Re-cementation, Medication, Restoration, Crowning / Capping, Implants, Braces up to INR 5000, Cashless + Reimbursement
Vision Wellness: Covers Consultations & check-ups by optometrist/optician, Prescribed glasses and frames up to INR 5000, Cashless + Reimbursement
Dermatology: Covers dermatology consultations and non-cosmetic treatments up to INR 1500, Cashless + Reimbursement
Excludes Food, Food Supplements or Dietary Pills even if prescribed
Excludes Dietary supplements and substances purchased without prescription unless prescribed by a medical practitioner as part of treatment
Excludes Inpatient hospitalization or day-care treatments under the policy
Excludes non-medical expenses or standard deductions during inpatient hospitalization or day-care treatments
Excludes Procedure fees or any type of procedures paid during an OP consultation (e.g., wound cleaning/dressing)
Excludes Over the counter (OTC) Medicines or medicines purchased without doctor's prescriptions
Excludes Diagnostic Tests/Investigations done without doctor's prescriptions
Excludes all cosmetic related consultations, diagnostics, and medicines unless explicitly specified in inclusions

Excludes Treatment for or related to alopecia, baldness, wigs, toupees, Alcoholism, drug/substance abuse, change in gender, IVF, infertility, Maternity, Management of pregnancy, obesity, AYUSH, physiotherapy, Cataract, Lasik, hearing aid, cosmetics
All claims must be raised within 45 days from the service taken date or claim can be rejected
Excludes AYUSH, physiotherapy, and cosmetic-related consultations

policy.text:
Inclusions:
Tele Consultation (GP & Specialist)
Online GP and Specialist consultations are covered
Type: Cashless
Limit: Unlimited
Health Check
1 Health Check per family
Type: Cashless
Limit: 1 Health Check (INR 1200)
In-Clinic Consultations (GP & Specialist)
All in-clinic Allopathy consultations are covered
Type: Cashless + Reimbursement
Limit: Up to INR 6000
Prescribed Diagnostics
Covers prescribed diagnostic tests across Pathology & Radiology (Prescribed by Allopathic practitioner)
Type: Cashless + Reimbursement
Limit: Up to INR 5000
Vaccination
Covers WHO-approved vaccinations for adults and children
Type: Cashless + Reimbursement
Limit: Up to INR 2500
Prescribed Pharmacy
Covers medicines prescribed by doctors(Prescribed by Allopathic practitioner) (unless excluded)
Type: Cashless + Reimbursement
Limit: Up to INR 5000
Dental Wellness
Covers:
Examination
Scaling and Polishing (in case of root canal and extraction)
X-ray
Fluoride Treatment
Filling
Prophylaxis
Root Canal Treatment
Extractions
Oral Surgery
Re-cementation
Medication
Restoration
Crowning / Capping
Implants
Braces
Type: Cashless + Reimbursement
Limit: Up to INR 5000
Vision Wellness
Covers:
Consultations & check-ups by optometrist/optician
Prescribed glasses and frames
Type: Cashless + Reimbursement
Limit: Up to INR 5000
Dermatology
Covers dermatology consultations and non-cosmetic treatments
Skin related consultations with dermatologists and Treatment related to skin which is non cosmetic in nature will be covered under Dermatology benefit only.
Type: Cashless + Reimbursement
Limit: Up to INR 1500
Top of Form
Exclusions:
(Which are not covered/ cannot be claimed for)
1. Food, Food Supplements or Dietary Pills (Example, Horlicks, Glucose, Whey Protein, etc.) even prescribed are not covered
2. Dietary supplements and substances that can be purchased without prescription, including but not limited to Vitamins, minerals and organic substances unless prescribed by a medical practitioner as part of treatment
3. Inpatient hospitalization or day-care treatments will not be covered under the policy
4. All non-medical expense or standard deductions incurred during inpatient hospitalization or day-care treatments will not be covered under OPD Policy
5. Procedure fees or any type of procedures of fees paid during an OP consultation are not covered. Example - wound cleaning/dressing
6. Over the counter (OTC)Medicines are not covered. Medicines purchased without doctor's prescriptions are not covered
7. Diagnostic Tests/Investigations done without doctor's prescriptions are not covered.
8. All cosmetic related consultations or diagnostics, and medicines (unless called out in inclusion) are not covered. Cosmetic Surgery or Treatment means surgery or medical treatment solely or primarily to improve or preserve physical appearance, but not physical function or treatment of an underlying ailment/conditions (Example - Chemical peel treatment, Laser hair removal and others). The exact nature of the procedure will be determined by claim adjudicators at the time of processing the claim
9. Treatment for or related to alopecia, baldness, wigs, toupees, Alcoholism, drug/substance abuse, change in gender, IVF, infertility, Maternity, Management of pregnancy, obesity, AYUSH, physiotherapy, Cataract, Lasik, hearing aid, cosmetics are not covered
10. All claims should be raised within 45 days from the service taken date, if not the claim can be rejected. Bottom of Form
11. AYUSH, physiotherapy, and cosmetic-related consultations : Not covered
